description: Daily stage counts from precomputed summaries
sql:
SELECT day_start_ms, stage,
             SUM(record_count) AS records
      FROM auto_trader_audit_daily_summary
      WHERE day_start_ms >= :since_ms
      GROUP BY day_start_ms, stage
      ORDER BY day_start_ms DESC, stage
limitations: Do not combine local and runtime results
Do not assume paper/live mode from table names
execution_plan: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
